english.title: Attempt to wound / cause grievous bodily harm without intent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), unlawfully and maliciously attempted to

(A)_[wound a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[inflict grievous bodily harm upon a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence should not be used. For a section 20 GBH the suspect must intend, or foresee, that the act might cause some harm: R v Savage and DPP v Parmenter (1992) It is not possible to attempt this offence because in order to attempt it, the consequence (wounding or GBH) must be intended, which is an offence contrary to section 18 instead.
